putBit\_unsigned

Sets the bit at selected position to bitValue of unsigned input value

Example Implementation:

Methods:

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| putBit | Sets the bit at selected position to bitValue of unsigned input value. |

Parameter:

| Parameter | Description | Implementation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| bitPosition | Bitpostion that needs to be set to 'bitValue' | uint8  OneToOne |
| bitValue | value to be set at specified position | uint8  (TRUE or FALSE) |
| bitLeiste | Input value | U16:uint16  U32:uint32   U8:uint8   OneToOne |
| return | Resultant value after the putBit operation | U16:uint16  U32:uint32   U8:uint8   OneToOne |
